other_conditions: Applicant must be an active or traditional fish farmer
Applicant must be living in a kutcha or thatched house
Applicant's family must be Below Poverty Line (BPL)
Applicant must not have previously benefited from the departmental fishermen housing scheme, Indira Awas, or any equivalent central/state housing scheme
Applicant must own land for house construction
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 for housing construction.
